description: The only CLI for the modern Agilix Dawn API — render a course's full structure, export curriculum and rosters, and mirror your catalog offline.

novel_features.name: Course structure tree
novel_features.description: Render a course's full section → instruction → interaction hierarchy as a tree.

novel_features.name: Course stats rollup
novel_features.description: Aggregate total instruction time, points, and section/instruction/interaction counts for a course.

novel_features.name: Curriculum export
novel_features.description: Flatten a course's section/instruction tree into a Markdown or CSV curriculum.

novel_features.name: Catalog drift
novel_features.description: Show what changed in the catalog since the last local sync (new/removed courses, price/status/title changes).

novel_features.name: Roster export
novel_features.description: Export users (id, name, email, status, verified) to CSV for reporting.

novel_features.name: Purchase reconcile
novel_features.description: Join purchases against user records to show who paid for what.

novel_features.name: Edit course metadata
novel_features.description: Update a course's title, description, price, or status (preview by default; --apply to write).

novel_features.name: Author sections
novel_features.description: Add, rename, or remove sections in a course (preview by default; --apply to write).

novel_features.name: Author instructions
novel_features.description: Add or remove instructions (lessons) within a section (preview by default; --apply to write).

novel_features.name: Add quiz question
novel_features.description: Add a typed multiple-choice question to a lesson (options + correct answers), preview by default; --apply to write.

novel_features.name: Add short-answer question
novel_features.description: Add a typed short-answer question to a lesson (accepted answers or coach review), preview by default; --apply to write.

novel_features.name: Resource inventory
novel_features.description: List the file resources (video, images, PDFs, SCORM) attached to a course, with sizes and content types.

novel_features.name: Enrollment groups
novel_features.description: List, create, or delete enrollment groups for a course (preview by default; --apply to write).

novel_features.name: Enroll and unenroll users
novel_features.description: Enroll or unenroll a user in a course by adding/removing them from an enrollment group (preview by default; --apply to write).
